description: Edit a LONG-FORM 16:9 talking-head video in the VIBECODE style — a saturated cobalt ground under cut-paper collage: torn notebook cards, a fake editing timeline drawn on ruled paper that builds block by block, scissored real screenshots, hand-drawn red X marks that kill the old way, heavy condensed poster caps, a pixel agent character, and stop-motion churn that updates on 2s. Ships a cream/gold alternate ground and a dark chapter teaser. Uses HyperFrames (HTML→MP4). This is the fourth house style alongside `nextphase-long-editing` (coral dotted grid), `motiongraphics` (violet glow) and `persa` (warm film grade). In Video Studio the style comes from the studio job; never ask.
